{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "Sjors",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK with caveats; objected to stopping on mismatch as an effective checkpoint (fixed), suggested keeping older commitments, and asked about flushing"
    },
    {
      "login": "optout21",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; suggested an option to skip the check and keeping older commitments for visibility"
    },
    {
      "login": "ajtowns",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected that crashing IBD on mismatch makes bad snapshot releases worse for everyone (fixed), asked about performance impact, and suggested alternative approaches"
    },
    {
      "login": "fametrano",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Concept ACK; confirmed abort on mismatch is fixed, and suggested persisting the warning across restarts"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:6229005853",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Stopping the node on a mismatch risks introducing an effective checkpoint that prevents normal sync if the snapshot commitment is malicious",
      "quote": "I think this risks introducing a new effective checkpoint. If the snapshot were malicious, normal users couldn't sync",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author changed mismatches to raise a GUI/RPC warning instead of stopping IBD",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "I have changed it to raise a GUI/RPC warning so ordinary IBD continues."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6229005853",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Limit the scope of the PR by checking the latest hash without deleting the older commitments yet",
      "quote": "Maybe limit the scope of this PR by only _checking_ the latest hash, but not (yet) deleting the other hashes.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author prefers keeping only the latest commitment to avoid complexity and false confidence",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "I'd rather keep just the latest commitment and remove the vector and lookup APIs."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6229005853",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Provide benchmark numbers in the PR description showing minimal performance impact",
      "quote": "It would be good to provide some numbers in the PR description.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author provided benchmark measurements showing no speed difference",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "My measurements indicate no speed difference whatsoever in total `-reindex-chainstate` time before and after this change."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6229005853",
      "part": 4,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "How does flushing chainstate to disk before hashing interact with current IBD flush frequency?",
      "quote": "I'm not up to speed on how often and when we flush the chainstate to disk during IBD nowadays. How does this interact with that?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained forced sync retains cache and schedules next write about an hour later",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "This PR adds a forced sync at the AssumeUTXO height, writing pending changes while retaining the cache before hashing the UTXO set."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6230060049",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Add a configuration option to bypass or ignore the AssumeUTXO hash check",
      "quote": "Introduce an option to skip the new AssumeUTXO hash check (may be a hidden option)",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author declined as mismatches no longer stop IBD",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "Since mismatches no longer stop IBD, I'd leave out the extra option to keep this change simple."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6230060049",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Keep non-latest AssumeUTXO commitments in source for visibility instead of dropping them",
      "quote": "So not checking the non-latest hashes is fine, but it's useful to keep them for visibility.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author prefers keeping only the latest commitment",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "I'd rather keep just the latest commitment and remove the vector and lookup APIs."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6379792380",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "question",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "What is the performance impact when hitting an AssumeUTXO commitment block during validation?",
      "quote": "What's the performance impact when hitting such a block?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author provided benchmark measurements",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "My measurements indicate no speed difference whatsoever in total `-reindex-chainstate` time before and after this change."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6379792380",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Crashing an IBD node on snapshot mismatch penalizes nodes with fully verified valid data while failing to protect snapshot users from following an incorrect chain",
      "quote": "Doesn't this make the result of a release including bad snaphot data worse for everyone -- Alice who does IBD has her node crash despite having good data that she fully verified, and Bob who uses the ",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author changed mismatches to raise a warning instead of stopping IBD",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "I have changed it to raise a GUI/RPC warning so ordinary IBD continues."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6379792380",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Consider predictable snapshot points (e.g. BIP 452) or including the block's muhash in the AssumeUTXO commitment to make verification easier and less disruptive",
      "quote": "Having predictable snapshot points (every 14112 blocks [per bip452]) would allow every node to calculate the appropriate hash... Including the block's muhash in the assumeutxo set would also probably ",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author preferred keeping the PR focused on checking the existing commitment",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6576337981",
      "status_by_quote": "Given how fast this is currently, I'd keep this PR focused on checking the existing commitment during ordinary IBD."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5643008477",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "A node failing the check aborts on an assertion due to inconsistent chainstate/coins tip, and a plain restart syncs past the commitment without checking it again",
      "quote": "a node that fails the new check aborts on an assertion, and a plain restart then syncs past the commitment without checking it again",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer confirmed the abort is fixed",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6576337981"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5740122673",
      "status_by_quote": "The abort I reported is gone at 396f6ddc."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5740122673",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Persist the AssumeUTXO mismatch warning across node restarts (e.g. using a flag in the block index database)",
      "quote": "Yes, the lost warning surprises me and I would keep it across restarts.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "open",
      "status_note": "",
      "author_replies": [],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "",
      "status_by_quote": ""
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:6229005853",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "see #32377, with two caveats",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6230060049",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "As there is a hash provided that requires trust, the more checks the better. It makes sense to use all nodes performing IBD to also perform this check, as it's relatively cheap to do.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5643008477",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "both",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "The author answered all open items and pushed changes so mismatches raise a GUI/RPC warning rather than halting IBD or aborting. fametrano confirmed the abort is fixed and suggested persisting the warning across restarts.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "decide whether to persist the mismatch warning across restarts",
      "id": "r:5740122673"
    },
    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "Sjors and ajtowns to review updated PR after author answered their comments",
      "id": "c:6576337981"
    }
  ]
}
